items.analysis: `programNext` (school.ts, extracted 2026-10-16 from `repeatRoom` and shared with `extraLater`) on a leave counts the leave’s first program term (firstTerm − offset before the leave). Without the branch, `academicTerm(termsBegun − 1) + 1` on a leave subtracts the whole leave from the term it began in, so it is n − 1 lower for a leave of n terms. `leaveLengths` grants only n = 2 while every year has year-long courses (checked against COURSES: years 1, 2 and 3 all have a/b courses), so the two paths count 8 vs 9 (no repeat) and 10 vs 11 (after one): the same side of nine in every reachable state. Only the Permanent Incomplete’s notice reads it on a leave (evaluations are called off with the leave).

rules.published: Published: “students must complete the degree requirements within nine semesters. Any approved leave of absence cannot exceed three semesters.”
rules.slate: SLATE counts semesters enrolled and leaves a leave’s terms out (its reading; the Bulletin doesn’t say whether leave semesters count toward the nine).

rules.published: Published: two Failures in a semester, three by the end of the second term, four by the third, five by the fourth, six by the fifth, seven in all; students “may be” disqualified.
rules.slate: SLATE’s faculty review of it (warning the first time, the year to repeat; dismissal on warning, after a review or with no room) is SLATE’s model, said so in the guide from 2026-10-16.

rules.published: Not published: no rule for repeating a failed acting course (searched 2026-10-16).
rules.slate: SLATE’s faculty model, under p.148’s “may vary specific requirements on an individual basis with the approval of the dean”; said so on the screen, the notice and the guide.
SLATE’s faculty model; said so in the grant notice and the guide.

rules.rule: The faculty’s review and its mark
rules.published: Published: the faculty evaluate regularly; concern, warning and dismissal may come at any time; concern informal, warning in a formal meeting with the chair and an associate dean.
rules.slate: One review a term at the classes’ end, its floors (attendance 90%, growth half the class’s pace, coursework half of three or more, a course failed, a run mostly off) and a step at a time are SLATE’s reading; said so on the Standing tab, the guide and the tutorial (2026-10-16).

rules.published: Published: personal, medical or parental; one, two or three terms; personal after one term completed, current, normally by the tenth day, not for a professional commitment; medical on a Yale Health physician’s written recommendation; mandatory leave by the dean with an appeal within seven days; notice of return eight weeks before; dismissal for not returning; Affiliate cover.
rules.slate: SLATE’s: the season rule on a leave’s length, five working days to decide, the physician’s view read from care in thirty days, the welfare triggers and the appeal’s test; said so on the panel’s Fine line and the guide. Parental leave isn’t modeled.

rules.published: Published: requested by the student and granted by the instructor; completed within one month of the term’s end; an extension by petition; else a Permanent Incomplete without credit. The SAP section (p.195) has Incompletes resolved by the next term’s registration day.
rules.slate: SLATE gives the Incomplete for meetings missed ill (not requested), owes make-up sessions (two hours, a week’s meetings each) and allows one extension of a month: SLATE’s, said so in the guide and on the screen from 2026-10-16. The Bulletin’s two deadlines disagree; SLATE keeps p.152’s month (uncertainty recorded).

rules.published: Published: attendance at classes, rehearsals, calls, work-study is required; unexcused absences are subject to disciplinary action; ill students email their professors and make up work on the professor’s schedule.
rules.slate: The three quarters of a course’s meetings that pass it is SLATE’s estimate (said so); the sick day is SLATE’s form of the email.

rules.published: Published: $40,750 tuition with 100% tuition support, ordinarily six terms, exceptions extremely rare; need-based living aid; late fees of $125 a month to $375 a term; Financial Hold withholding registration and the diploma.
rules.slate: SLATE’s aid office’s exception (a medical leave made the extra terms) is SLATE’s model, said so in its notice.

rules.published: Published: fall term from 24 August 2026, classes 31 August to 11 December; spring term 4 January 2027, classes 11 January to 23 April; University Commencement 24 May 2027.
rules.slate: The evaluation at five on the classes’ last day, and later years’ dates, are SLATE’s.
